test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Transient
solution: The correct answer is '**Temporary**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Transient**' is '**Temporary**'. • **Transient**: lasting or continuing for a short period of time. (कुछ अवधि तक जारी रहनेवाला; क्षणिक, क्षणभंगुर, अस्थायी) • *Example: **transient** anger...* • **Temporary**: lasting for a short time; not permanent. (अल्‍पकालिक, अस्‍थायी) • *Example: a **temporary** job...* **Correct Answer:__** *Temporary.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Transform**: to change somebody/something completely, especially in a way which improves him/her/it. [किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु को पूरी तरह बदल देना (विशेषतया उसमें सुधार लाते हुए), (का) रूपांतरण कर देना] • **Transmit**: to send out television or radio programmes, electronic signals, etc. (टीवी या रेडियो कार्यक्रमों, विद्युत संकेतों आदि को प्रसारित करना) • **Trap**: a piece of equipment that you use for catching animals. (जंतुओं को पकड़ने के लिए प्रयुक्त फंदा; जाल) 1d0:T10d6, The correct answer is **She said to me, “Why were you smoking today?”**
